rationale: Ground truth centers on three threads: reviewers questioning why the model reads cudagraph_mode (a runner concern), demands for full before/after benchmark evidence, and the NPU PIECEWISE yaml fix plus the seed-reproducibility follow-up note. Y directly engages the benchmark gap (explicitly asks for accuracy A/B given the seed-reproducibility change, cites the PR's own RTF/TTFP numbers) and discusses the NPU yaml addition's intentionality, giving it meaningfully higher recall against actual reviewer concerns. X's findings are grounded and well-evidenced but almost entirely about missing test coverage for the new async/graph flags — a real but different concern that none of the human reviewers raised, so it scores much lower on recall despite being accurate. Both are concrete with file/line references and actionable asks, so actionability is comparable; precision is similar since neither fabricates claims.
